documentation.content: An account hit the daily prompt rejection limit, or an answer was withheld for an allergen or a leak. See functions/README.md, "Prompt injection defences".

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND (jsonPayload.message="prompt_rejection_limit" OR (jsonPayload.message="prompt_output_rejected" AND jsonPayload.code=("OUTPUT_ALLERGEN" OR "OUTPUT_LEAK")))
